meta.name: Ensure Athena Workgroup should enforce configuration to prevent client disabling encryption
meta.description: Ensure Athena Workgroup should enforce configuration to prevent client disabling encryption
meta.remediation: Leave enforce_workgroup_configuration at its default (true) inside the aws_athena_workgroup configuration block, never set it to false.

evaluators.description: No aws_athena_workgroup may set configuration.0.enforce_workgroup_configuration to false. A list-valued NotContainedIn passes on an explicit null, and error_tolerance 2 skips a workgroup with no configuration block at all.
